decisions.decision: «екран» is preferred over «матрица» in customer-facing text site-wide; child slug is smyana-na-ekran.html
decisions.rationale: User decision 2026-08-20. Customer-facing titles/h1s/nav/meta/body use «екран»; «матрица» retained only as a precise part reference (bare LCD panel, part specs, or a customer quoting another shop). Deliberately reverses existing usage — live site ran матриц- 14x vs екран 5x.

decisions.decision: CSS comments are stripped at DEPLOY time, not deleted from source
decisions.rationale: components.css was ~60% comments by raw bytes; the tree was 2,234 B OVER the 20,480 B transfer budget, not 27 B under. scripts/lib/strip-css-comments.py (string-aware, not regex) wired into deploy-new.sh took production CSS 22,714 -> 5,309 B gzipped. Source keeps the rationale that prevented the CR-01/CR-02 defects in Phase 2.

decisions.decision: Category 6 ships structure with zero invented claims, promotion gated on a boolean
decisions.rationale: User decision. No source material exists anywhere for this category. Fabricated service claims on a repair shop's site are a real-world harm — customers act on them.

decisions.decision: Google rating badge built but gated OFF by default with an emptiness safety net
decisions.rationale: User decision. GBP review status was never verified; a badge pointing at an empty or non-existent profile is worse than none.

decisions.decision: origin/main must be pushed level with HEAD before every wave dispatch
decisions.rationale: Claude Code's isolation='worktree' forks from origin/HEAD, and the worktree.baseRef:'head' setting is not honoured mid-session (the harness also strips the key when it rewrites settings.local.json). Wave 1 halted on a base mismatch until origin was realigned. `git remote set-head origin -a` fixed origin/HEAD resolution permanently.

context_notes: Phase 3 execution is fully done: 9/9 plans merged, deployed to https://torin.bg/new/, and independently live-verified. 23 pages all return 200 with zero PHP warnings and zero source leak; every svc-page/trust-signals probe PASSES at 360x640 and 1440x900; SEO-01 verified independently of the plan's own gate (23 distinct titles, 0 duplicates, 0 empty descriptions, descriptions 87-139 chars, X-Robots-Tag noindex on 23/23 which is correct for staging). The live site at torin.bg/ is untouched throughout — all work is confined to the public_html/new/ staging subtree. What remains is process, not code: no VERIFICATION.md was ever produced because the user invoked /gsd-verify-work directly rather than letting execute-phase reach its verify_phase_goal step. The single most important lesson of this phase is that local gates cannot validate PHP on this project — the $torin_page global collision passed every local gate and shipped HTTP 200 while rendering the single letter 's' where the prose belonged. Only the live deploy caught it.
